registrar_rulings.reason: Swept all three namespaces plus the feed and alias map for bourbon/whiskey/whisky/liquor/spirit: every hit is an EXCLUDE pattern (dozens of per-commodity excludes in commodities.json and the GLOBAL exclude list in recipe-commodities.json lines 59-63) - no id anywhere prices any spirit, the recipe board carries none, and smp-feed.json has no price cell for it or any whiskey. Not a duplicate and no variant candidate exists; white-wine (live at Baker's, $0.1571/floz) is a different food, not this purchase. Namespace ruling: mint in commodities.json (weekly staples) exactly as white-wine is - it must NOT go in recipe-commodities.json, whose global excludes ('bourbon','whiskey','wine') would self-exclude the row, and white-wine's placement shows commodities.json is where cooking alcohol lives. Prescription: id 'bourbon', unit floz, include patterns like \bbourbon\b requiring whiskey context; the exclude list needs the ~150-pattern rigor and MUST cover the bourbon-FLAVORED estate the existing excludes were built against - bourbon BBQ/sauce/marinade/glaze, bourbon chicken meal kits/bowls, bourbon cashews/walnuts/honey (the FDC hits are exactly these wrong foods - transcribe a real bottle label instead), 'Madagascar bourbon' vanilla extract, bourbon-barrel-aged foods, and cream liqueurs. No allowlist entry needed since no near id exists; run audit-commodity-dupes.ps1 after minting to confirm zero suspects. Edits via add-commodity-rule.ps1 by the caller/Brad.
